title: Lisan character-look references

presentation.placement: Inside the existing character collection, after its cover summary.
presentation.sourceAction: Open the existing asset and provide its exact full-size original.

scopeNotice: Each row has its own scope and evidence class. Existing selections remain scoped; this draft adds no ratings, stages, criteria passes or new creative acceptance.
portraitContext: The relayed human direction accepts visible variation between the two portrait looks; they need not be carbon copies. Core identity and AL/GAIB lettering remain required. That statement does not approve unseen body details or derivatives.

rows.label: Natural face and neck marks
rows.scope: Existing identity reference for the visible face, natural teeth and neck marks. No automatic ink-criterion binding.

provenance.summary: Current identity nomination and existing character cover; earlier selection history was reported by Chief.

A later relayed Ziggy statement accepts both this portrait and the outfit portrait as character/look examples. CFA Nova owns the pending canonical portrait rating import; this board does not write it.

limitations: Single near-frontal bust with a slight head tilt; no back, opposite neck or full-body view.
Visible teeth and marks are static evidence; motion consistency is not demonstrated.

unresolved.summary: Complete the pending portrait rating import and any explicit face-mark criterion binding without changing the source or extending its scope.

rows.label: Signature stillsuit and cloak
rows.scope: Outfit only: the visible signature stillsuit and cloak. This nomination does not govern face, body build or the whole scene.

provenance.summary: The same relayed Ziggy statement accepts both portrait looks. CFA Nova owns the pending canonical portrait rating import; the board retains this row's outfit-only nomination.

limitations: Chest-up crop; lower garments, boots, back and overall body proportions are not visible.
Cloak and chain obscure parts of the neck and torso; the background does not establish a scene reference.

unresolved.summary: Complete the pending portrait rating import while preserving the outfit-only board scope.

rows.label: Optional breather with natural teeth
rows.scope: Settled optional combination: breather, natural teeth and no grill. Does not set default face, artwork, jewelry or outfit.

provenance.summary: A retained coordinator observation records the actual scoped human selection on 2026-10-09. The direct transcript is not embedded; provider self-scores are not human ratings.

limitations: One front rest view; the breather and tube obscure part of the nose and cheek.
Slightly parted lips show some natural upper teeth; lower teeth and the mouth interior are mostly hidden. No articulation or continuity proof.

unresolved.summary: Bind the existing scoped selection in the owner records. The absence of a sidecar does not require the user to repeat the settled choice.

rows.label: Optional iced grill design
rows.scope: Exact optional grill design only. Natural teeth remain the default; the historic face, tattoos and piercings are outside this selection.

provenance.summary: An exact canonical user Keep record already exists for this optional grill design, recorded on 2026-10-09. This board preserves that scoped record and creates no new nomination.

limitations: Near-frontal portrait shows the visible front grill design; rear teeth, side fit and other angles are not established.
The surrounding historic face details are not an identity standard, and motion consistency is not demonstrated.

unresolved.summary: Reconcile matching optional mouth views to the existing grill-design choice without broadening it. No repeated human confirmation is needed solely for a missing sidecar.

rows.label: Body-build candidate
rows.scope: Provisional full-body candidate only; no accepted physique role or body-build approval is established.

provenance.summary: Existing catalog candidate with provider QA, awaiting accuracy review. Provider QA is not human acceptance.

No side or back view; the face is small. Exact body dimensions or unseen anatomy cannot be inferred.
